import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root = Path('results/expansion')
path = root / 'mistral_budget_plan.json'
protocol = root / 'protocol-mistral-budget.json'
command = ['bash', 'scripts/with_resource.sh', 'nim', '.venv/bin/python', '-u',
           'scripts/expand_nim.py', '--models', 'mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b',
           '--protocol-file', protocol.name]
record = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {
    'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'one validation availability probe with room for reasoning and final JSON'}, 'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
    'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'command': command,
    'status': 'waiting_for_original_baseline_resume',
    'documentation': 'https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/mistralai-mistral-large-4-1t-a52b-infer',
    'hypothesis': 'The 4096-token omitted-field control returned reasoning only with finish_reason=length. A 16384-token cap may permit final JSON. This is an availability change, not test-score tuning.',
    'controls': 'Same validation availability state: dice seed 80000, round 2, temperature 0.3, 600-second timeout, three attempts. Preserve both earlier failed probes without repeating them. If usable, evaluate seeds 200-399 on both games with a distinct label. Preserve reasoning_content in repair conversations as required by the model API.',
    'prior_protocol': 'results/expansion/protocol-mistral-default.json',
    'prior_protocol_sha256': file_sha256(root / 'protocol-mistral-default.json')}
if not protocol.exists():
    protocol.write_text((root / 'protocol-mistral-default.json').read_text())
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
while json.loads((root / 'intermittent_resume_plan.json').read_text())['status'] != 'finished':
    time.sleep(30)
record['status'] = 'acquiring_slot_then_running'
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
result = subprocess.run(command)
record.update(status='finished', exit_code=result.returncode)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')

If usable, evaluate seeds 200-399 on both games with a distinct label. Preserve reasoning_content in repair conversations as required by the model API.
